cadence.title: Polling cadence
cadence.description:
How often the integration polls the TTLock cloud. Locks also update in near real time via webhooks, so these can stay high to keep multi-lock accounts under TTLock's free-tier API-call limit. Lower the poll interval if your webhooks are unreliable.

**With the currently saved settings and your {locks} connectable lock(s), scheduled polling makes about {estimate} API calls per month.** After saving, reopen this form (or check the 'TTLock API Calls Estimated Monthly' sensor) to see the recalculated number.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to re-check whether each lock is locked or unlocked, in minutes.
data_description.slow_poll_interval: How often to refresh slow-changing detail (battery, name, autolock and passage-mode config, gateway signal, PIN codes and eKeys), in hours.
data_description.gateway_poll_interval: How often to check whether gateways are online, in minutes. One API call per check, regardless of how many locks you have.
data_description.webhook_only: Once webhooks are confirmed working, stop re-checking lock state against the cloud on every poll and rely on webhooks (and Bluetooth, if in range) instead. Saves one API call per lock per poll; only the initial state after a restart is fetched from the cloud.
data_description.manual_sync: Disable ALL scheduled polling. Data is fetched only at startup, when you press a sync button, or via the update_state action. Webhooks and Bluetooth still update lock state in real time. Overrides the intervals above.
